name: PT Esa Medika Mandiri Tbk
summary: PT Esa Medika Mandiri Tbk supplies laboratory, pharmaceutical, and medical equipment for human use in Indonesia. It offers anesthesia machines, electrocardiographs, electrosurgery units and ultrasonic scalpels, examination and operating lights, high flow oxygen therapy, minimal invasive surgery systems and instrument sets, modular operating theatres, obstetric units, operating tables, patient monitoring, surgical instruments, surgical sutures, infusions and syringe pumps, and ventilators. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Tangerang, Indonesia.
